connectors.evidence_source: metadata docs_url; Docker's provider-published latest Docker Hub OpenAPI YAML export
connectors.counting_note: Docker's provider-published latest Hub YAML exposes 54 HTTP operation objects: 24 GET, three HEAD, 12 POST, four PUT, five PATCH, and six DELETE. Thirteen authentication/access-token operations are credential infrastructure (three login/token exchanges plus all ten personal/org token-management actions) and are excluded consistently with r1's token-flow convention. Of the remaining 41 data operations, GET/HEAD actions are reads and POST Verify repository immutable tags is a semantic read; the other six POST, four PUT, three PATCH, and four DELETE actions are writes. No inbound event type is described by this artifact.
connectors.selection_reason: selected explicitly after provider-artifact quality review; the record independently satisfies the machine-readable, versioned, public, bounded-operation evidence gate
